understood_as: Source-only two-row census and review packet; retain three owner-confirmed marks and 하, identify additional visible strokes independently in raster, never render or promote new candidates.
coordinate_convention: Original page pixel edges; integer x/y; right and bottom exclusive; crop-local (0,0) maps to page bbox left/top; no scaling
measurement_policy: After source-only visual identification, record the tight L<127 dark-support bbox inside each independently selected local window, plus the full window and its unchanged native pixels. This is a reproducible diagnostic bbox, not complete antialias extent or ink ownership. No fixed threshold is used to confirm meaning or grant editing.
noncandidate_context: m6 has 7 confirmed syllables per row, with continuation between the fourth and fifth syllables; m8 has no newly observed lyric continuation stroke. Empty/unobserved regions are visual observations, not independently established absence.
renderer_policy: No predictions or alpha masks are regenerated, edited, or added. New candidate rendering is blocked pending explicit owner approval.
coverage_policy: Inspect all 8 measure-row regions, including spaces between marks, and record negative observations separately from ownership and renderer completeness. Agent census is not independent completeness proof.
